name: Default
shortDescription: InfluxDB 3 Core time series database with an HTTP API for writes and SQL or InfluxQL queries, local file object storage and a preconfigured admin token.

alerts.message: InfluxDB 3 Core has no built-in web UI. Authenticate API and client requests with the generated admin token stored in the INFLUXDB3_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable. The token is registered on the first start; changing the variable later does not change the server's token.
